description: This Java source file defines MainActivity, an Android activity that manages a ViewPager with multiple fragments, synchronized with ActionBar tabs. It includes an inner class SectionsPagerAdapter for providing fragments for each page and a static inner class DummySectionFragment for displaying placeholder content per section.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing a ViewPager with tab navigation, implementing ActionBar.TabListener.

classes.name: MainActivity.SectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: FragmentPagerAdapter that supplies fragments for each page of the ViewPager.

classes.name: MainActivity.DummySectionFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment displaying section number, used as content for ViewPager pages.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up ActionBar tabs and ViewPager with adapter, synchronizes tab selections with page changes.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection, updates ViewPager to corresponding page.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a fragment for the given position, passing section number as argument.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns localized title for each page based on position.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout for the fragment and sets section number text.
